classifications.rationale: The President directs agencies to provide staff resources and expertise when requested by the Director, an internal interagency coordination and resource-allocation measure without itself changing legal rights or dictating a later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: make its resources in staff, and knowledge and experience available to the Economic Stabilization Agency

classifications.rationale: The segment mandates internal administrative assistance through temporary personnel assignments, information sharing, services, facilities, and field-office notification; these are executive-management measures rather than prescribed legal consequences.
classifications.evidence: each agency shall provide such cooperation and assistance, consonant with law, as it can
